notes: Start Bercianos del Real Camino is the end of stage 18 (same object, same coordinates). El Burgo Ranero is the relation 346903 (place=village) and Mansilla de las Mulas the relation 340885 (place=village); Photon shows no separate place node for either, and reverse geocoding puts both points inside the villages (Calle El Norte; Calle de la Concepción). Reliegos is a hamlet node. The Calzada Romana variant that leaves the Camino at Calzada del Coto (see stage 18) rejoins around Reliegos (general knowledge, not checked).
